cases.name: Independent manufacturer admission
cases.positive: Unrelated ZA external customer is admitted with CP-issued independent tenant, legal actor and explicit entitlement; zero DigitalEstate succeeds.
cases.negative: Nabhold INTERNAL classification, group inherited admin, forged legal entity, fake estate and missing grant are denied.
cases.required_evidence: Independent CP tenancy/context, no Nabhold access, plan/apply and no-estate snapshots.

cases.name: Unsubscribed buyer exchange
cases.positive: UG-BUY-01 can buy from ZA-MFG-01 through governed external-party commercial flow without a Baobab tenant or vendor API requirement.
cases.negative: A supplier/buyer application cannot manufacture canonical verified identity or claim direct tenant access; unknown buyer is refused.
cases.required_evidence: External counterpart and scoped contract, denied tenant API, authorised buyer process.

cases.name: Buyer promotes to independent tenant
cases.positive: UG-BUY-01 becomes own EXTERNAL_CLIENT tenant with its already verified canonical Organisation identity; relationships persist only as authorised.
cases.negative: Duplicate canonical ID, automatic access to seller records, group-privileged scope or retroactive edits are denied.
cases.required_evidence: Organisation reconciliation, idempotent provisioning, current grants and independent projections.

cases.name: Current bilateral legal actor authority
cases.positive: Current seller and buyer legal actor, Market, site, role, capability and mandate are independently resolved at execution.
cases.negative: Wrong audience, revoked grant, expired mandate, mismatched legal actor or another tenant cannot execute.
cases.required_evidence: Real IAM token, CP decision/expiry, native commit veto and denial readback.

cases.name: Quote and buyer commitment
cases.positive: RFQ, quotation, commercial terms and buyer commitment are persisted at the authorised Trade native commit fence.
cases.negative: B2C classification fallback, stale spend approval, null limit, forged quote or duplicate commitment cannot bypass the fence.
cases.required_evidence: Bound actor decision, quote/version, money commitment, idempotent DB readback.

cases.name: Imported component procurement
cases.positive: External component supplier purchase contract/order and customs-import provenance reach manufacturer's ERP under its legal actor.
cases.negative: Missing KYB, unauthorised PO, foreign AD_Client/AD_Org, unverified customs basis and synthetic supplier tenant assumption are rejected.
cases.required_evidence: Native purchase and matching state with CP decision and source classification.

cases.name: Goods receipt and landed cost
cases.positive: Real native material receipt attributes imported lots, freight/duties/costing to correct inventory and payable.
cases.negative: Quarantined lot, mismatched landed cost, duplicate receipt, customs unknown and negative inventory bypass rejected.
cases.required_evidence: Stock quantity, invoice match, cost/valuation postings and negative DB rollback.

cases.name: Manufacturing BOM and work order
cases.positive: Approved versioned BOM and manufacturing order consume permitted inputs and maintain full provenance from imported components.
cases.negative: Unmapped component, BOM version drift, wrong manufacturer client/org, unqualified production plugin or missing authority refused.
cases.required_evidence: Real iDempiere 13 process/API, BOM version, component supply and native veto.

cases.name: Native production financial consequence
cases.positive: Native consumption, WIP, output and finished goods generate balanced, correctly attributed Fact_Acct without inventing inventory.
cases.negative: Direct SQL bypass, stale posting period, foreign organisation, unbalanced journal or double production order fail closed.
cases.required_evidence: iDempiere JVM/PG17 work order, Fact_Acct, transaction boundary and rollback proof.

cases.name: Quality, serial and lot genealogy
cases.positive: Inspection accepted finished pumps have traceable serial/lot chain to imported input and controlled release.
cases.negative: Failed quality inspection, unknown source lot, forged genealogy, unapproved serial reassignment or release on quarantine denied.
cases.required_evidence: End-to-end input/output link, test result, hold/release author and immutable history.

cases.name: Country-rule and origin determination
cases.positive: Evaluate effective-dated ZA exporter/UG importer requirements, actual product-specific origin and tariff evidence with source-pinned decision.
cases.negative: Assembly alone does not assert preferential origin; ambiguous HS, expired source, unknown rule or missing origin data yields UNKNOWN/BLOCKED.
cases.required_evidence: Rule hash/effective date, source provenance, input BOM/valuation, reasoned decision and denial.

cases.name: Customs documentary requirements
cases.positive: Complete legally required evidence workflow for configured corridor with versioned documents and authorised release decisions.
cases.negative: Missing/revoked document, stale evidence, mismatched consignee, unauthenticated official clearance or inferred permit disallowed.
cases.required_evidence: Versioned controlled docs, issuer, decision, custody and denied access.

cases.name: Shipment and carrier orchestration
cases.positive: Independent manufacturer books through certified transport provider, receives state and evidence from accepted carrier.
cases.negative: No Thamani compulsory, fake ETA/booking, repeated carrier booking, unauthorized tracking/custody access or false carrier qualification denied.
cases.required_evidence: Real provider identity/version, signed status, custody handoff, receipt/replay controls.

cases.name: Export and import reciprocal fulfilment
cases.positive: Actual export handover and UG buyer receipt are independent consequences of verified origin/customs/transit and delivery records.
cases.negative: No shipment or importer receipt on unverified release, lost custody, wrong destination, duplicate delivery or revoked clearance.
cases.required_evidence: Cross-party shipment document, commercial transfer terms, delivery verification and separate ledgers.

cases.name: Bilateral AR/AP, FX and landed cost
cases.positive: Exporter AR/GL (ZAR), Ugandan buyer AP/GL (UGX) and USD contractual amount reconcile with recognised FX and landed cost, separately governed.
cases.negative: Shared mutable invoice, mismatched currency, rate basis, legal actor or balance; journal posting through native bypass denied.
cases.required_evidence: Two independent real native client journals, cross-document reference, rate/rounding and balancing evidence.

cases.name: Payment and settlement reconciliation
cases.positive: Verified buyer settlement instruction is authorised and reconciled to independent payables and receivables when provider outcome known.
cases.negative: ERP payment record cannot move money; wrong destination/amount, revoked authority, PSP timeout or uncertain result cannot trigger blind replay.
cases.required_evidence: Separate Payments dispatch/PSP receipt, payer/merchant identity, idempotency, ERP readback.

cases.name: Cross-engine replay and failure recovery
cases.positive: Version-pinned events/outbox/inbox, source migration pins, interrupted recovery and quarantine reconcile exactly once across participants.
cases.negative: Duplicate source event, unsupported version, broker outage, partial success or conflicting replay must not duplicate purchase/production/payments.
cases.required_evidence: Crash recovery receipt, negative DLQ/replay, independent hash/source validation and teardown.

cases.name: Tenant isolation, historical rights and recovery
cases.positive: Independent external buyer offboarding/revocation preserves immutable cross-border evidence while all former live access is denied; restore tested.
cases.negative: Cross-tenant ledger/CRM/doc read, corporate ownership shortcut, stale identity, forgotten secret, failed restore or incomplete teardown fails.
cases.required_evidence: Revocation/absence proof, independent data denial, historic immutable custody, restore and host cleanup.
